jobs_results.description:
Role


Junior Frontend Developer
Job Type


Fulltime
Experience Required


0–1 Years
Job Location


Bangalore
Junior Frontend Developer
This opportunity is ideal for aspiring developers who want to build their careers through practical experience with modern frontend technologies. You will collaborate with engineering, design, and product teams to create simple, effective interfaces for business and customer needs.


This position focuses on developing responsive web applications, converting design ideas into functional user interfaces, integrating frontend systems with backend services, and contributing to agile development processes. You will work with modern JavaScript frameworks while helping deliver high-quality client projects.


Success in this position depends on strong frontend basics, curiosity, and a genuine interest in building better user experiences. The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, and willing to learn and grow within a fast-paced engineering team.


Job Responsibilities:
Build and maintain responsive UI components using React or Angular
Collaborate with designers and backend engineers to translate wireframes into functional interfaces
Write clean, readable, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews, daily standups, and sprint planning
Communicate clearly with internal team leads and, when required, with clients
Skills required:
Proficiency in React.js or Angular (one strong, other a plus)
Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+)
Familiarity with Tailwind CSS or similar utility-first frameworks
Basic understanding of REST APIs and how frontend integrates with backend
Strong communication skills — written and verbal
Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow fast
Perks & Benefits:
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives that recognize your contributions and growth.
Comprehensive health coverage, wellness initiatives, and free health checkups to support your well-being.
Access to modern tools, technologies, and learning resources to enhance your skills and career development.
A collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and knowledge sharing.
Employee recognition programs, awards, and referral bonuses that celebrate outstanding performance.
Flexible work arrangements that help support a healthy work-life balance.
Opportunities to participate in team engagement activities, learning sessions, and professional development programs.
Modern office facilities with collaborative workspaces, ergonomic seating, recreational areas, and cafeteria services.
Opportunities to contribute to meaningful projects and work alongside experienced professionals across diverse domains.

jobs_results.title: Junior Frontend and Backend Assistant (Bengaluru)
jobs_results.description:
About Us: Dtech Information Technology and Outsourcing Pvt Ltd is part of Delight Investment Group Holding Ltd, a diversified group operating across logistics and supply chain, facilities management, oil and gas products and services, and information technology and outsourcing. The Marketing division leads brand presence, digital engagement, and creative output across the group's business lines.  

About The Role: This is a full-time Junior Web Developer role in a hybrid setup, with the primary location in Bengaluru and flexibility for some work from home. The Junior Web Developer will assist in building, testing, and maintaining web applications, working with both front-end and back-end components under the guidance of senior developers. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing clean, maintainable code, implementing web designs, fixing bugs, and supporting integration with APIs and databases. The role involves collaborating with designers and other developers, participating in code reviews, and updating existing features to improve performance and usability. The Junior Web Developer will also help document technical specifications and stay current with best practices in up-to-date web development.  

Key Responsibilities:  
- Website maintenance: Update and maintain existing websites, including content updates, bug fixes, and routine performance checks.  
- Landing page development: Build and publish campaign landing pages in coordination with the Social Media Strategist and design team.  
- Front-end development: Implement layouts and components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring responsive design across devices.  
- CMS management: Manage content and page updates through the website's content management system, primarily WordPress.  
- On-page SEO: Apply SEO fundamentals such as meta tags, alt text, and page speed optimisation to new and existing pages.  
- Testing and QA: Test pages across browsers and devices prior to publishing, and troubleshoot reported issues promptly

Job Role: Frontend Developer - 2+ Years - Immediate Joiner 

Location: Bangalore




Company Overview

IAI Solution Pvt Ltd. operates at the edge of applied AI where foundational research meets real-world deployment. We craft intelligent systems that think in teams, adapt with context, and deliver actionable insight across domains.




Position Summary

We are looking for a Front-End Developer (2+ Years experience) to join our team in Bengaluru, India with strong expertise in front-end technologies like JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, and Next.js, as well as a solid understanding of back-end development, including database management and data structures and algorithms (DSA). The ideal candidate will have experience working with both SQL and NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB, and be proficient in using Git for version control. Must-Have Skills

Good-to-Have Skills

Experience with animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion)Exposure to SaaS platform developmentKnowledge of testing frameworks (Jest, Cypress, React Testing Library)Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices


Preferred Qualifications

Contributions to open-source projects or strong GitHub/portfolio demonstrating advanced front-end work.Experience in AI-driven platforms or SaaS-based product companies.


Perks & Benefits

Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses.Opportunity to work on cutting-edge real-time audio/video applications.Flexible working hours .Access to the latest development tools and technologies.
